update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.11 - Fix dating schedule getting stuck
Fixed ----- - The bot could get stuck forever on the same turn opening and closing the "Choose Recreation Partner" dialog if a recreation attempt backed out without completing an outing (e.g. a configured card's name didn't match any row). The bot now falls through to a normal action for the rest of that turn instead of retrying immediately, and logs a clearer warning if this happens (it usually means a card's "Card Name" was set to its preset label, like "Team Sirius", instead of the actual in-game support card name).
